coverage_of_risk.rationale: No tests exist at all; the riskiest logic (data transformation, filtering, sorting, URL state, error paths) is entirely uncovered by anything the team will own.

evidence: app/ — grep for *.test.* / *.spec.* and describe/it/expect returns no matches
behaviour_not_implementation.rationale: There are no tests, behavioural or otherwise.

evidence: app/app/components/MovesTable.vue:54-59 — missing Category is the string '—' (app/app/pages/pokemon/[name].vue:152), so the 'missing sorts last' rule silently fails and no test notices
app/app/utils/poke.ts:80-87 — any API error (500/network) is collapsed to null and rendered as 'Not found'; no test distinguishes outage from 404
regression_power.rationale: Nothing in app/ can fail; a refactor that breaks filtering, sorting, URL state or error handling would ship undetected once the fixture-specific acceptance suite stops being the only guard.

evidence: app/ — zero test files, so zero low-value tests to maintain
signal_to_noise.rationale: No tests means no noise, per the rubric's 'no tests: 3'; there is also no signal.

findings.issue: No test script, no test runner, no devDependencies — the app has no safety net beyond the fixture-specific acceptance suite in tests/.
findings.suggestion: Add Vitest + @nuxt/test-utils (the stack Nuxt 4's testing docs prescribe, supported by test-utils v4) and a `test:unit` script; start with unit tests for app/app/utils/poke.ts.

findings.issue: The spec's 'missing values sort last in both directions' only holds for null; Category is '—' and Type falls back to '' (app/app/pages/pokemon/[name].vue:151-152), so those columns sort alphabetically instead of last — a live spec deviation nothing would catch.
findings.suggestion: Normalize missing category/type to null in the row model and add a unit test over sortedRows covering both directions with missing values present.

findings.issue: fetchRecord converts every error (including 500s and network failures) to null, so an API outage renders valid resources as 'Not found' with a 404 status (app/app/pages/pokemon/[name].vue:172-173).
findings.suggestion: Only map 404 to null; propagate other errors to an error page, and add a test that a 500 from the API does not produce the not-found page.

findings.issue: Filtering, the 48-per-page slice, page clamping and 'Page n of total' are unguarded; an off-by-one or a changed PAGE_SIZE would pass every existing check.
findings.suggestion: Extract the filter+paginate computation into a pure function and unit-test boundaries: empty results, exactly-48, page out of range, combined filters.

findings.issue: URL-state sync is untested: default-param omission (page/q/type/generation), filters resetting page, debounced search using replace vs push, and a possible race between the 250 ms debounce and a select push.
findings.suggestion: Add component tests (mountSuspended) asserting the URL after typing, changing a select on page >1, and back/forward navigation.

findings.issue: Index builders — species sort by id, the id>=10000 form exclusion, per-slot type dedupe (:158-165) and the species→generation map — are only pinned by a few acceptance assertions on this data snapshot.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test getTypeIndex/getGenerationIndex/getSpeciesIndex against small synthetic API payloads, including an alternate-form entry and a species missing from generation data.

findings.issue: Move-table assembly (per-game grouping, method ordering Level Up/Machine/Egg/Tutor then alphabetical, dedupe, default sort) and the ?game= fallback (:154-158) are untested; onGameChange (:175-183) also drops the game param when the default is re-selected, a spec nuance nothing pins.
findings.suggestion: Extract table assembly into a testable function fed a small moves payload; add a test for ?game= round-tripping including selecting the default game.

findings.issue: cardsFromPokemonRefs (form exclusion, dedupe, dex ordering, hidden-ability flag via URL match in app/app/pages/abilities/[name].vue:13-22) has no tests; the 'deoxys-normal maps to the species' rule is only covered by one fixture case.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with refs containing an alternate form, a duplicate and a default variety pointing at a different Pokémon id.

findings.issue: The promise cache's subtle behaviours (failed fetches must not be cached, eviction must not delete a newer entry) are untested; a regression would permanently break a resource for the process lifetime.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test fetchApi with a stubbed $fetch: success cached, rejection evicted, retry succeeds.

findings.issue: Excluded-type guarding (EXCLUDED_TYPES → not found) and the catch-all route (app/app/pages/[...path].vue) are untested edge paths.
findings.suggestion: One test each for /types/shadow and an arbitrary unknown URL asserting the Not-found h1.

summary: The app contains no tests of its own — no runner, no test script, no devDependencies — so every behaviour rests on acceptance tests the team won't own. Reading the risky logic surfaced at least one live spec deviation (missing Category/Type don't sort last in MovesTable) and one error-handling cliff (any API failure renders 'Not found'), both invisible to the current suite. Adding Vitest with @nuxt/test-utils and starting with unit tests over app/app/utils/poke.ts plus the home filter/pagination and move-table assembly would close the highest-risk gaps cheaply.
